preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 500.
The number of edges m must be between 0 and the maximum possible number of edges in a graph with n vertices.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect valid vertices and no vertex can connect to itself.

postconditions.description: The output must be 'Yes' if a valid string exists, otherwise 'No'.
If a valid string exists, there must be two lines in the output; otherwise, there must be one line.
If a valid string exists, the second line must contain a string of length n.
